relationship_to_the_execution_record.method: This record is ADDITIVE. The execution record is preserved byte-identical as historical evidence, exactly as commit b227d21b's NOT_RECEIVED state was preserved. A finding that turns out to be overstated is corrected by a successor record, never by editing the original.

F-01.as_written_in_the_execution_record: No EMILIA native output exists in this contour, for any case.
F-01.verdict_on_that_wording: OVERSTATED. It is true for five of the seven cases and false for two.
F-01.corrected_statement: No EMILIA native output exists in this contour for H-01-b, H-01-c, H-02, H-03 or B-01, and no frozen INTEROP-002 procedure defines how to produce one for them. For C-00 and H-01-a, pre-existing frozen EMILIA native outputs DO exist: they were produced by EMILIA's own verifier at commit 9a04bea7 - the same commit every INTEROP-002 fixture pins - and are bound by input digest to bytes byte-identical to those two cases, inside the digest-verified INTEROP-001 final-candidate package.
F-01.how_the_error_arose: The execution driver searched the INTEROP-002 tree, found emilia_input and emilia_baseline but no native result, and generalized to 'this contour'. It did not search the sibling INTEROP-001 package that a tracked adapter in this same repository already reads. The generalization was mine and it was too broad.
F-01.what_survives_of_F_01: The substantive gap is real and unchanged: the frozen charter presupposes a native output from each system (section 10 step 5, section 11.1 item 3, section 16), yet no frozen INTEROP-002 procedure produces one for the five INTEROP-002-specific cases, and section 16 never asks the contributor for one. B-01 in particular has no EMILIA native output and no defined way to obtain one.

F-02.status: PRESERVED, UNRESOLVED, NOT RESOLVED BY CONVENIENCE
F-02.statement: The frozen H-SUFF condition 'every precommitted expectation relevant to the conclusion reproduced' admits two readings.

narrow_reading.content: Bridge sufficiency is a property of the WEXP bridge, so only the WEXP expectation is relevant. It reproduced 23/23.

broad_reading.content: Both parties' precommitted expectations are relevant to the conclusion of a two-party interoperability experiment.
broad_reading.yields: H-SUFF INCONCLUSIVE, because the EMILIA expectation for B-01 cannot be verified without an EMILIA native output for B-01, and none exists

F-02.applied_in_the_execution_record: narrow, explicitly flagged at the time rather than chosen quietly
F-02.does_the_new_discovery_settle_it: NO. The discovered native outputs cover C-00 and H-01-a. The EMILIA expectation at issue is the B-01 expectation, and B-01 remains without an EMILIA native output. F-02 is exactly as open as it was.
F-02.why_it_is_not_resolved_here: Choosing the reading that yields the stronger verdict, on my own authority, is the precise failure mode this experiment was built to avoid. The reading is a joint question for the Founder and the contributor.

F-03.statement: H-03 and C-00 assemble a byte-identical AppraisalInput (b0f77acf...). Refused expansions and refused authority conversions leave no residue in the constructed input.

F-04.statement: Even the complete frozen case set cannot decide BE-03 or BE-06. A limit of the case set, not a defect found in the bridge.

F-05.statement: Case-level relations for C-00 and H-01-a are now potentially decidable against real EMILIA native outputs, rather than underdetermined.
F-05.not_done: No relation was derived. This order prepares a fairness package; it does not authorize new comparison, and it forbids repair.
F-05.requires: a separate Founder order if the Founder wants those two relations derived
F-05.caution: Any such derivation must respect that the INTEROP-001 outputs were produced by correspondence under a different experiment identity, with assurance class IA-0 as that package's own adapter records. They are not INTEROP-002 execution products and must not be presented as though they were.
